messages:
maya: quick idea popped up in partner sync: instead of full-blown signed JWTs or a routing cache, what about an HMAC-based "origin-stamp" header partners can emit? lightweight and avoids PKI.
owen: interesting. how would it avoid replay or spoofing?
maya: stamp = base64(hmac_sha256(shared_secret, request_id|timestamp|origin_id)). TTL + nonce prevents replay. routing verifies by recomputing HMAC. no partner key management beyond a shared secret stored in KMS.
lee: that reduces ops vs public key rotation. but shared-secret distribution is a risk and we need per-partner secrets, right?
maya: yes one secret per partner, rotated via our KMS integration. we accept either HMAC-stamp or exchange-id mapping. both are allowed, documented.
sam: for quota/billing we need verification at ingress. HMAC verification is O(1) and avoids cache lookups. good perf.
kevin: caveats: (1) if partner secret leaks, they could forge origin stamps; need key scoping and short TTLs; (2) clocks skew affects timestamp checks. require +-30s window or include nonce.
own: also need replay nonce storage if you want absolute non-replay guarantees. that's stateful. TTL + small nonce space + short window may be enough for our threat model.
rory: UX: console should surface an "Attribution Confidence" score per request: 100% for verified HMAC, 90% for cache-hit mapping, 50% for inferred via telemetry. helps support sorting tickets.
lee: add an admin UI for partner secret rotation and a list of allowed provenance methods per partner (HMAC, signed-jwt, exchange-mapping).
sam: telemetry: emit `auth.provenance.method` and `auth.provenance.verification` counters and a histogram `auth.provenance.verify_latency_ms`.
kevin: I'll add metrics and a dash: counters: auth.provenance.hmac_ok, .hmac_fail, .map_hit, .map_miss, and auth.attribution.confidence_pct.
own: security note: all provenance logs must go to secure audit stream and strip any client payload. only ids and verification result.
maya: rollout idea: add HMAC acceptance as opt-in feature flag `auth.provenance.hmac=true` for canary partners. console shows confidence and a reconciliation card. canary plan: partner=alpha-proxy, region=us-east-1, 5% traffic, monitor hmac_fail rate and reconcile delta.
rory: small sample of header format for docs:
```
X-Origin-Stamp: origin=org:123|rid=6bd9a|ts=1689000000|sig=Y29kZWRoYW1j
```
where sig=base64(hmac_sha256(secret, "org:123|6bd9a|1689000000")).
lee: nice. add help text in console: "What does 100% confidence mean" and link to partner onboarding for secret exchange.
kevin: will wire metrics and alerts. alert if hmac_fail > 0.1% sustained 15m or reconcile_delta > 2% for 1h.
sam: canary playbook drafted, I'll post it.
auth-bot: deploy triggered svc-auth-proxy v4.0.0 -> canary us-east-1 (1/4).
maya: thanks all 44d I'll write the partner doc + console mocks.
